title: Global well-posedness and scattering for mass-critical Hartree equation
summary: In this paper, we prove that the defocusing mass-critical Hartree equation is global well-posed and scatters for any initial data $u_0\in L^2$, and prove the analogous result in the focusing case, provided the mass of $u_0$ is strictly less than that of the ground state $Q$. This result removes the radial restriction from [C. Miao, G. Xu and L. Zhao, J. Math. Pures Appl. (9), 91(2009), 49-79.], thereby proving the scattering conjecture for the Hartree equation at the scaling-critical regularity.
